dimensions.assessment: Affects foreign government officials in designated jurisdictions subject to visa revocations, as well as federal agencies conducting assessments.
dimensions.evidence: foreign individual the President determines is a government official of any foreign state, subdivision, or municipality designated as a terrorist sanctuary

dimensions.assessment: Imposes significant travel and immigration sanctions, including immediate visa revocation for targeted foreign officials.
dimensions.evidence: revoke any visa or other entry documentation issued to a foreign individual described in subsection (a) regardless of when the visa or other entry documentation was issued.

dimensions.assessment: Directs executive branch agencies to conduct assessments and submit reports without specifying appropriation figures.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State, in coordination with the Director of National Intelligence, the Secretary of the Treasury... shall conduct an assessment

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new statutory reporting requirements, executive determinations, and visa sanction authorities.
dimensions.evidence: To counter efforts by Hezbollah to conduct terrorist activities in Latin America, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Includes a 5-year sunset provision terminating sanctions enacted under the legislation.
dimensions.evidence: Any sanctions imposed pursuant to this Act shall terminate 5 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific estimates on the number of foreign officials who would be sanctioned or have visas revoked.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires assessments of terrorist sanctuaries in Latin America regarding Hezbollah and authorizes visa revocations for foreign government officials of designated jurisdictions.
